messages:
Maria P.: Heads-up: schedule change — code freeze moved UP to 16:00 UTC today (was 19:00). Were tightening the window because of the infra maintenance tonight. Please treat today as a hard freeze unless you follow the exception flow below.

Maria P.: Exception rules (short):
- Allowed: urgent bugfixes, security patches, customer-facing regressions.
- Not allowed: new features, experimental toggles, perf experiments.
- Required in PR: link, short risk summary, smoke steps, exact rollback image/tag, test artifacts or perf run.
- Labels: `late-merge`, `risk:high|medium|low`. Tag @eng-runtime and @eng-infra for runtime changes.

release-bot: :rotating_light: Freeze updated: 16:00 UTC. Submit exception requests via /release-exception and add `late-merge` label.

Jake L.: small one: version bump + changelog for sdk package (no binary change). Do I need full exception? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789

Maria P.: Docs/version-only with zero behavioral change = auto-allow. Add `docs` and `release:allow-docs` in PR body and mark `late-merge` just for tracking. No further approvals.

Sophia R.: We have a kernel regression in the attention layer causing memory drift on long sequences. Repro locally. This touches runtime and infra configs. High risk.

Maria P.: Runtime-touching fixes require two approvers: one from eng-runtime and one from eng-infra. Also include an explicit rollback command and container tag to revert to. If approved, we open a 20-minute manual window.

Ryan C.: For hotfix path: cherry-pick onto the release branch and prepare a canary rollout. Typical commands:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout release/v1.5.x
git cherry-pick -x <commit>
git push origin release/v1.5.x
```
Create PR against release/v1.5.x and attach smoke script. Canary rollout example (k8s):
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=registry.redwood/release:v1.5.2-hotfix-<id> --namespace=prod-canary
# monitor canary metrics: curl -s https://canary-metrics.internal/last24h | jq .latency_p50
```

eng-oncall: If manual window opens, I'll watch canary and be ready to flip rollback or cut traffic. Leave me exact healthchecks.

Sophia R.: Understood. We'll include perf traces and the old image tag `registry.redwood/release:v1.5.1` to roll back to. Opening exception request now with checklist filled.

Maria P.: Good. When opening exception request, title it: "late-merge: <short PR summary>" and paste this checklist in the body: PR links, risk, testing steps, rollback tag, approvers (runtime/infa). If eng-runtime approves within 15m, we schedule 20m window starting at a concrete time. If not, escalate to @release-leads.

release-bot: :white_check_mark: Exception submitted: REQ-840. Notifying reviewers. Deadline for reviewers to respond: 15 minutes.

Jake L.: Quick q: changelog format for docs-only bump? We use unreleased -> packages: sdk: "chore: bump sdk to 2.3.0". That ok?

Maria P.: Yep. Keep it one-liner under Unreleased and reference PR.

Sophia R.: REQ-840 updated with perf output and smoke script. Tagged eng-runtime and eng-infra. Requesting 20-minute window at 15:40 UTC.

eng-runtime: Reviewed. We need one more signoff from eng-infra and a short load test result.

eng-infra: Reviewing now. If load test looks good, I can greenlight and @eng-oncall can start the manual window.

eng-oncall: Ready to monitor. Please include `canary_id` and healthcheck URL in PR body.

Maria P.: Final reminder: freeze at 16:00 UTC. Any non-exception merges after that will be reverted. If you think you may need an exception, start the request *now*. :lock:

Jake L.: done on the docs PR, added labels and changelog.

Sophia R.: infra approved, eng-runtime approved. Manual window scheduled 15:40 - 16:00 UTC. Will push cherry-pick and start canary at 15:40.

release-bot: :bell: Manual exception window opened for REQ-840 (15:40 - 16:00 UTC). Monitoring enabled.

Ryan C.: Canary started. smoke script output attached to PR. All clear on initial checks.

eng-oncall: Watching metrics. p50/p95 stable. No errors in logs. :white_check_mark:

Maria P.: If rollback needed, use this command (example):
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=registry.redwood/release:v1.5.1 --namespace=prod
```
Make sure the rollback tag is the one listed in the PR.

Sophia R.: Hotfix merged into release/v1.5.x and backported to main. Thanks all for quick reviews.

Maria P.: Closing thread: freeze in effect at 16:00 UTC. For any late issues, open a post-freeze incident and well triage. Thanks.
